title: Ordinary completed constant-model transport
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring and d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For an ordinary module sheaf M over the completed continuous quotient tower, its stratified finitely presented scalar-model condition [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models] is equivalent, after restriction along the canonical completed-ring comparison, to the completed constant scalar-model condition [def-sfb-completed-constant-stratified]. Neither a derived object nor its completeness is involved.

proof.text: The two constant-to-completed scalar maps have the same finite quotient projections. Uniqueness in the limit gives equality. Cancellation of the forward and inverse coefficient restrictions identifies integralConstantModule with the completedAdicChange realization.

Scalar restriction along a ring isomorphism commutes with inverse image to each stratum and with restriction to its slice site. Apply this equivalence and its inverse to every local-model isomorphism, retaining the covering sieve and the finitely presented scalar module.
Forget or adjoin the constructibility fields of the stratification without changing its schemes or immersions. This yields both directions of the two existential model predicates.

proof_origin.place: Definition 6.8.10, Proposition 6.8.11(3), and the projection-normalized coefficient comparison; Stacks 099C, 099M, 09C1, 09C2 and 09AL as applicable.

lean.statement:
theorem completedConstantModelTransport (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)) :
    IsIntegralStratifiedFinitelyPresented X d M ↔
      IsCompletedConstantStratified X d.ideal
        ((pbcRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom).obj M)
